entries.0c1d2d8d05e73d34: Centered on the Kansai and Tokai regions, this business purchases, develops, leases and sells real estate, mainly residential condominiums and office buildings. It also develops and sells small rental apartments and residential condominiums, and is a stock-type business that earns rental income and sales income. The company and City Home Co., Ltd. are responsible for this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥4,052 million.
entries.0fbe0554e6a6578f: This business acts as an agent for fire insurance, earthquake insurance and other insurance products derived from the group's real estate-related services.
entries.25aa105adf1c784d: Its main customers are home buyers, mainly first-time buyers, property sellers and buyers, rental tenants and people seeking renovation. No specific customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue from external customers.
entries.2617ae58d65901d4: Newly built detached houses for sale
entries.2677e426f18ebbd9: Its strength is locally rooted sales: it limits each store's trade area to a radius of about 2.5km and collects, understands and accumulates local real estate information. Local information and customer needs gained through brokerage are also used in acquiring and developing land for sale. With its 5 businesses (brokerage, sales, rental, construction contracting and insurance agency) working together, the group can handle everything from home purchase to renovation and insurance.
entries.45a8a7b7dd2e599e: This is the group's core business, dating back to the company's founding, and handles brokerage for the purchase and sale of, and sales agency for, all types of real estate, including detached houses and condominiums, whether new or used. The company operates 9 stores mainly in Osaka Prefecture and Fukuoka Prefecture, and also operates in Aichi Prefecture through City Home Co., Ltd. and Aidemu Home Co., Ltd. Its distinguishing feature is community-based sales, which limits each store's trade area to a radius of approximately 2.5 km from the store and gathers and accumulates local real estate information. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,285 million.
entries.47727bf121439c85: The basic strategy is to maximize synergies through closer collaboration across 5 business fields (real estate brokerage, newly built detached house sales, construction contracting, non-life insurance agency and real estate rental), and, under a locally focused sales strategy limited to specific areas, to raise market share in each trade area and build a long-term revenue model by turning local customers into lifetime customers. In the real estate brokerage business, it will expand distribution of “low-priced newly built homes” and “quality used homes” suited to current needs, strengthen capture of renovation demand, and promote new store openings, including entry into new areas. In the newly built detached house sales business, it will advance the provision of detached houses for sale centered on free-design homes.
entries.4bdee15192e693db: A company based in Osaka, Fukuoka, and Aichi that centers on the sale of newly built detached houses and real estate leasing, and provides housing services in an integrated way, including brokerage, construction contracting, and insurance agency.
entries.5e35b19a93793331: This business undertakes contracts for custom-built homes, standard-design homes (brand name: Garenkāsa) and renovations. It responds to a wide range of customer needs arising from linkages with and derivatives of the real estate brokerage business and the new detached home sales business. Rifosuta Co., Ltd. undertakes renovation contracts, and Aidemu Home Co., Ltd. undertakes custom-built home and renovation contracts. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,323 million.
entries.60765ac36ca11081: This is the group's core business, dating back to the company's founding, and handles brokerage for the purchase and sale of, and sales agency for, all types of real estate, including detached houses and condominiums, whether new or used.
entries.680b3db40f0285bb: It operates five businesses: newly built detached house sales, real estate rental, real estate brokerage, construction contracting and non-life insurance agency. The brokerage business is characterized by a locally rooted sales approach that limits its trade area to a radius of about 2.5km from each store.
entries.6b48dcccafca703e: Centered on newly built detached houses for sale to first-time buyers, the company combines development and sale of rental properties, real estate brokerage, custom-built homes and renovation contracting, and non-life insurance agency services, supporting housing from acquisition through to ownership.

entries.e5b902222d908ed5: Of revenue of ¥16,928 million for the fiscal year ended December 2025, newly built detached house sales accounted for ¥9,219 million, the majority, followed by real estate rental at ¥4,052 million. It operates 25 locations in the Kansai, Kyushu, Chubu and Okinawa areas, and by region of sales, Osaka Prefecture is central across each business. No specific customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue from external customers.
entries.edb9db6858357dce: This business develops and sells newly built houses for sale, mainly targeting first-time buyers who form the core of homebuyers, through small and medium-sized projects of around 10 to 20 units. Based on information gathered through community-based sales activities and analysis of customer needs, it acquires and develops land for sale, and builds and sells homes through separate contracting to outside contractors and construction management by its own site supervisors. Consolidated subsidiary Rifosuta Co., Ltd. purchases and resells used properties, and City Home Co., Ltd. sells land. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥9,219 million, the largest of the five reportable segments.
